items: While Google Drive sync is on, your Google picture now sits at the top of the app on every screen, so you can always see which account is syncing. Tap it to open the sync settings.
Photos taken late in the evening are now filed under the right day, wherever you live.
New on the Backup page: erase everything this app keeps on this device. Your Drive copy stays safe.
Before you pick an athlete, the app matches your device's light or dark setting.
New coaching advice from your coach folder now waits for you to review it before it replaces the old advice, and you can undo it.
Easier-to-read text by default, and you can choose a different font on the Dashboard.
